finalText:
**Big, but mostly safe.** `account_id` appears 1,291 times across 94 files.

Six places must keep the old name:

| Place | Hits | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `migrations/*.sql` | 61 | Already ran live. Editing breaks the undo step. |
| SQL text in `repo/` files | 125 | No migration renames the column. |
| `JSON.stringify` payload keys | 25 | Old stored rows would stop matching. |
| `req.session.account_id` | 100 | Set outside this repo. |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/` | 20 | `npm run vendor:refresh` wipes edits. |
| `docs/openapi.yaml`, `lib/serialize.js` | 7 | Public field. Breaks every client. |

That leaves about 950 safe renames. Those are local names in service and route files.
